title: Page 2
content_zh:
“那把年纪都可以当初荷的祖父了，两人竟然还成亲，真恐怖！”
平静无波的湖面旁，一座雅致的凉亭里两个少女正在对弈。
“昨儿个下午，好几个茶艺社的格格来我家，假装说是要找我，实则意图见我大哥。”气质冷艳的敦华格格拿起一颗白子，凝神思索后放入棋局中。
“我知道。她们本想要我居中牵线。”初荷盯着棋局，移动黑子吃掉一颗白子。
敦华扯动细眉，瞥她一眼。“妳还去参加她们的活动？”
“打发时间呗。”初荷的黑子再下一城，连连进攻。
“真服了妳。我就算闷得发慌，也不想去那种闲言闲语社。”敦华冷笑，极不认同。
“其实挺有趣。”初荷不以为意。
茶艺社的官家千金、皇室格格当中好些个都十分崇拜兰泗，时常会谈论到他的消息，而这个就是她想参加的原因；只是，这层关系她无论如何都不会透露，尽管敦华是她的好友，她仍是难以启齿。
“等这局下完，我得拿药去给我大哥。”敦华审视棋局，苦思反攻对策。
“怎么还需要妳亲自送药？”初荷拿着黑子，抬起头来讶问。
“额娘担心大哥闷闷不乐会出事，家里又属我和他感情最深，所以额娘让我送药时顺便陪他说话解闷。”敦华睇她一眼。“该妳啦。”
“妳大哥好些了吗？”初荷拿着棋子欲下。
“妳等会儿若有空，跟我一起去瞧瞧不就知道了。”敦华再催：“该妳啦。”
初荷微怔，下棋的手有些晃动，随意将黑子搁下。“那就一起去吧。”
敦华眼睛一亮，迅速将她误入陷阱的棋子吃下，攻城略地大反击。
“妳输了，真难得。”她笑了笑。胜棋关键，攻心为上。
“比赛本来就是有输有赢。”心知肚明输棋原因，初荷脸上闪过一丝不易察觉的羞涩。
敦华看在眼里，却没说破。“走吧，咱们去看我大哥。”
阒静无声的院落，数十个下人和侍卫守在外头，瞧见前来的格格，随即无声行礼，分成两列站开，让她们进去。

“大贝勒睡下了？”敦华停在门口问着贴身伺候兰泗的小厮。
“刚醒来，正在看书呢。”小厮轻声细语，显然怕惊扰到尚未痊愈的贝勒爷。
“咱们进去吧。”敦华领着跟在后头的初荷走进屋内。
初荷好奇打量这满是书册的屋子，一派的清幽简单，无半分华丽摆设，全然不像富贵子弟的房间，更何况礼亲王府还是贵族中的贵族，兰泗更是备受尊宠的嫡长子。
“大哥，我送药来了。”敦华轻喊。
初荷随着敦华的视线望过去，一个白净清瘦的男子倚在炕上，修长的手指正翻著书册，瞧见她们后，露出一贯的斯文笑容。
“怎好每回都麻烦妳亲自送药。”兰泗朝着走在后头的初荷点头致意，俊俏的脸颊犹有病容，唇色稍白。
“不麻烦。”敦华递过一碗乌黑难闻的药汤，初荷瞧了，忍不住微微蹙眉，兰泗却连眉头都没皱，一口气喝完。
“坐，我让人沏壶茶。”兰泗看向始终站在敦华身边的少女，知道她是小妹的闺中好友。
“今天可有好些？”敦华问着。初荷闻言，也盯着兰泗。他瘦了不少，连脸颊都有些凹陷了。
“嗯。”他点点头。“早上太医也说我好得差不多了。”
“可有想吃什么？皇宫送来许多糕点……”敦华懊恼的猛然住口，就连初荷也立即联想到，早就听说兰泗的青梅竹马最嗜吃各式茶点糕饼。
果然，她瞥见兰泗脸上闪过一抹不自然神色。
“我让人拿些冰露梅子茶过来好了。”敦华连忙转移话题，可兰泗却怔忡了起来，心事重重了好半晌。
“敦华，帮我个忙，阿玛不让我的人送信出府，妳将这封信拿去给她。”兰泗取出揣在怀里的信。
“大哥你怎这么死心眼！”敦华气恼的站了起来。“这信都送了十几封，要回早就回了，你这是何苦！”
兰泗眼神黯淡下来，略为难堪的别开脸，眉宇间却有着不容撼动的固执。
初荷被那抹痴心的神情给牵引住，竟听见自己不由自主的开口。“不如，就让我帮忙送信吧。”
僵持不下的兄妹同时讶异的看向她。
“妳怎么也跟着起哄！？”敦华不悦。

初荷有些心虚，不敢直视敦华的目光，只是垂下眼帘轻轻说着：“只是送个信而已。”
敦华盯着好友半晌，忽然起身。
“算啦！我不理这事儿了，要不要送信、怎样送信，你们俩自个儿去说吧。”她说完就走，独留下兰泗和初荷。
兰泗凝眉看向窗外，手上还抓着那封信。
“她……真有这么好？”不该问的，初荷自知失言，一阵仓皇，直想拿了信就赶紧离开，没想到兰泗竟然开口回答。
“好或不好都没关系，我始终向着她。”
“可她已经嫁人了。”尽管她向来寡言，可既然开口了，干脆问个清楚。
兰泗朝她微笑。“只要她还愿意，我就会等下去。”
初荷恍惚的看着他，心想，这世上竟真有如此痴情的男子；她想起自己阿玛替她订下的婚事，再看看兰泗坚定的神情，顿时心中百味杂陈。这般真情至性的模样，她怕是会永远刻在心头，抹不去了。
兰泗终究还是接下巡视边疆营区的职务。礼亲王高兴得不得了，特别派遣好些个王府里武艺高强的侍卫跟随，福晋也特地酬神谢佛，欣慰着王府的嫡长子终于想通开窍，愿意担负起家族兴盛的重责大任。
反倒是正主儿完全提不起劲儿，彷佛任人摆布的玩偶，尽管大病初愈，却明显的比以前沉默寡言，笑容也从他俊逸斯文的脸庞褪去。
“明天就要启程了，怎不早点歇息？”冷夜，雅致的花园里，敦华赫然发现兰泗独坐凉亭品茗。
“睡不着。”他淡然一笑。
“也难怪。你这一趟至少得半年才能回来。”敦华幽幽的说着：“等你回来时，说不定我都已经大婚了。”
兰泗替她斟茶。“怎么了，妳今晚竟比我还落寞？”
“初荷……”敦华暗叹。“大哥总知道初荷是谁吧？”
他凝眉想了半晌。“似乎听妳提过这名字。”
“你竟然不知？！亏她上回还自告奋勇要帮你递信。”这对向来处事冷静的初荷来说是多么不容易的事，结果备受关爱的那个人却是浑然不知。虽然听初荷说兰泗最终没将那信托她送出去，但敦华仍是在心底替好友感到难过。
兰泗想起来了，那个总是跟在小妹后头的女孩儿，原来她叫初荷啊。“怎么忽然提起她？”
“初荷明天要嫁人了。”她微微垂下眉眼。

“妳舍不得闺中好友吗？男大当婚，女大当嫁，这是常情，更何况就算她成了亲，妳们也还是有机会见面。”
“初荷要嫁给远在东北守陵的简亲王。”敦华看向兰泗。
他停住喝茶的势子，略为错愕，若没记错的话……“简亲王不是快六十了吗？”
“刚过六十寿辰。”
“怎会订下这等亲事？”兰泗蹙眉。虽说他对那个女孩儿没什么印象，但听闻此事，总让人心生同情。
“福大人亲自安排的婚配，还拿了简亲王丰厚的聘礼。”
看来今晚睡不着的不只有他一人，许多人都有着无法遂愿的人生啊。兰泗轻啜一口茶，抬头望向银勾般的弯月，黑白分明的俊眸透着几许心事。
content_en:
"You are so old that you can be Chu He's grandfather, but the two of you are still married. It's really scary!"
Beside the calm lake, two girls were playing chess in an elegant pavilion.
"Yesterday afternoon, several princesses from the tea club came to my house, pretending to be looking for me, but in fact they wanted to meet my eldest brother." Dunhua Princess, who had a cool temperament, picked up a white stone, thought about it carefully and put it into the chess game.
"I know. They originally wanted me to play the role in the middle." Chuhe stared at the chess game, moving the black stone to capture a white stone.
Dun Hua raised his thin eyebrows and glanced at her. "Are you still going to participate in their activities?"
"Let's pass the time." Chuhe's Heizi took another victory and attacked again and again.
"I really admire you. Even if I get bored, I don't want to go to that kind of gossip club." Dun Hua sneered, strongly disagreeing.
"It's actually quite interesting." Chu He didn't take it seriously.
Many of the officials' daughters and royal princesses in the Tea Club admired Lan Si very much and would often talk about him. This was the reason why she wanted to join. However, she would not disclose this relationship anyway. Even though Dun Hua was her good friend, she still found it difficult to talk about it.
"When this game is over, I have to get medicine for my big brother." Dun Hua looked at the chess game and thought hard about counterattack strategies.
"Why do you still need to deliver the medicine in person?" Chu He raised his head and asked in surprise as he took the sunglasses in hand.
"Eniang was worried that something would happen to my eldest brother if he was unhappy, and I have the deepest relationship with him at home, so Eniang asked me to talk to him to relieve his boredom while delivering medicine." Dunhua glanced at her. "It's your turn."
"Is your brother feeling better?" Chu He held the chess pieces and was about to play.
"If you are free later, come with me and have a look." Dun Hua urged again: "It's your turn."
Chu He was slightly startled, his chess-playing hand shook a little, and he casually put down the black piece. "Then let's go together."
Dun Hua's eyes lit up, and he quickly captured her chess piece that had fallen into the trap by mistake, and launched a counterattack by attacking the city.
"It's so rare that you lost." She smiled. The key to winning chess is to attack the heart.
"There are always winners and losers in the game." Knowing the reason for losing, Chu He's face flashed with a trace of imperceptible shyness.
Dun Hua saw it but didn't say anything. "Let's go see my elder brother."
In the silent courtyard, dozens of servants and guards were standing outside. When they saw Princess coming, they immediately saluted silently and stood in two lines to let them in.
"Is Big Belle asleep?" Dun Hua stopped at the door and asked the boy who was waiting on Lan Si.
"I just woke up and was reading a book." The boy whispered softly, obviously afraid of disturbing Lord Beile, who had not yet recovered.
"Let's go in." Dun Hua led Chu He, who was following behind, into the house.
Chu He curiously looked at the room full of books. It was quiet and simple, without any gorgeous furnishings. It didn't look like the room of a wealthy child at all. What's more, Prince Li's Mansion was a noble among the nobles, and Lan Si was the eldest son who was highly respected.
"Brother, I'm here to deliver the medicine." Dun Hua shouted softly.
Chu He followed Dun Hua's gaze and saw a fair and thin man leaning on the kang, flipping through a book with his slender fingers. When he saw them, he showed his usual gentle smile.
"Why do I bother you to deliver the medicine in person every time?" Lan Si nodded to Chu He who was walking behind. Her handsome cheeks still looked sick and her lips were slightly white.
"No trouble." Dun Hua handed over a bowl of dark and unpleasant medicinal soup. Chu He looked at it and couldn't help but frown slightly, but Lan Si didn't even frown and drank it in one go.
"Sit down, I'll let someone make a pot of tea." Lan Si looked at the girl who was always standing next to Dun Hua, knowing that she was her little sister's best friend.
"Are there any better today?" Dun Hua asked. When Chu He heard this, he also stared at Lan Si. He has lost a lot of weight, and even his cheeks are a little sunken.
"Yeah." He nodded. "The imperial doctor also said this morning that I'm almost healed."
"Do you want to eat anything? The palace sent a lot of cakes..." Dun Hua suddenly stopped in annoyance, even Chu HeI also immediately thought of it. I had long heard that Lan Si’s childhood sweetheart loved to eat all kinds of tea cakes and cakes.
Sure enough, she caught a glimpse of an unnatural look flashing across Lan Si's face.
"I'll ask someone to bring some ice dew and plum tea." Dun Hua quickly changed the subject, but Lan Si became startled and worried for a long time.
"Dun Hua, do me a favor. Amma won't let my people deliver the letter out of the house. Take this letter to her." Lan Si took out the letter in her arms.
"Brother, why are you so stubborn!" Dun Hua stood up angrily. "I sent this letter more than a dozen times. I would have answered it a long time ago. Why are you bothering!"
Lan Si's eyes dimmed and she turned away slightly embarrassed, but there was an unshakable stubbornness between her brows.
Chu He was attracted by that infatuated look and actually heard himself speaking involuntarily. "Why don't you just let me help deliver the letter."
The deadlocked brother and sister looked at her in surprise at the same time.
"Why are you making noise too!?" Dun Hua was displeased.
Chu He felt a little guilty and did not dare to look directly into Dun Hua's eyes. He just lowered his eyes and said softly: "I'm just sending a letter."
Dun Hua stared at his friend for a long time, then suddenly stood up.
"Forget it! I'll ignore this matter. It's up to you two to decide whether to deliver the letter and how to deliver it." After she finished speaking, she left, leaving Lan Si and Chu He alone.
Lan Si frowned and looked out the window, still holding the letter in her hand.
"She...is she really that good?" She shouldn't have asked. Chu He knew that he had made a mistake, and he was in a panic. He wanted to take the letter and leave quickly, but he didn't expect Lan Si to answer.
"It doesn't matter if it's good or bad, I'm always facing her."
"But she is already married." Although she has always been reticent, now that she has spoken, she might as well ask clearly.
Lan Si smiled at her. "As long as she is willing, I will wait."
Chu He looked at him in a daze, thinking that there really was such an infatuated man in this world; she thought of the marriage that her Ama had arranged for her, and then looked at Lan Si's determined expression, and suddenly she felt mixed feelings in her heart. Such a sincere look would be etched in her heart forever and she would never be able to erase it.
Lan Si finally took over the duty of inspecting the border camps. Prince Li was so happy that he sent many of the palace's highly skilled guards to follow him. Fujin also specially thanked the gods and Buddhas. He was pleased that the eldest son of the palace had finally figured it out and was willing to take on the important responsibility of the family's prosperity.
On the contrary, the master was completely unmotivated, like a doll at the mercy of others. Although he had just recovered from a serious illness, he was obviously more taciturn than before, and the smile had faded from his handsome and gentle face.
"We're going on a journey tomorrow, why don't you rest early?" On a cold night, in the elegant garden, Dun Hua suddenly found Lan Si sitting alone in the pavilion drinking tea.
"Can't sleep." He smiled lightly.
"No wonder. It will take at least half a year for you to come back from this trip." Dun Hua said quietly: "By the time you come back, maybe I will already be married."
Lan Si poured tea for her. "What's wrong, are you even more lonely than me tonight?"
"Chuhe..." Dunhua sighed secretly. "Big brother always knows who Chuhe is, right?"
He frowned and thought for a long time. "I seem to have heard you mention this name."
"You don't know?! Fortunately, she volunteered to deliver the letter for you last time." This was not an easy thing for Chu He, who had always been calm in dealing with things, but the person who was loved by him had no idea. Although Chu He said that Lan Si did not give her the trust in the end, Dun Hua still felt sad for his friend in his heart.
Lan Si remembered that the girl who always followed her little sister turned out to be Chu He. "Why did you suddenly mention her?"
"Chu He is getting married tomorrow." She lowered her eyebrows slightly.
"Are you reluctant to let go of your best friend? It's normal for a man to get married and a girl to get married. What's more, even if she gets married, you still have a chance to meet."
"Chu He is going to marry Prince Jian who is guarding the mausoleum in the northeast." Dun Hua looked at Lan Si.
He stopped drinkingCha's attitude was a little startling. If I remember correctly... "Isn't Prince Jian almost sixty?"
"Just passed my sixtieth birthday."
"How could you arrange such a marriage?" Lan Si frowned. Although he had no impression of that girl, hearing about this always made people feel sympathetic.
"Master Fu personally arranged the marriage and received a generous betrothal gift from Prince Jian."
It seems that he is not the only one who cannot sleep tonight. Many people have lives that cannot fulfill their dreams. Lan Si took a sip of tea and looked up at the crescent moon like a silver hook. Her black and white handsome eyes showed a little bit of her thoughts.
